'''Selana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] with the [[Oquan]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] group that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naalol/Legends|Naalol]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] procurement [[Officer/Legends|officer]] Lieutenant [[Talnar]] crash-landed on Naalol and the Oquan planned to capture him, so that they could sell him to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Selana and the Oquan lieutenant [[Patch]] subsequently led a group of 15 Oquan that subdued Talnar and took him captive.<ref name="Talnar" />
